description: Yin-yang symbol animated as two fish in eternal pursuit. Each fish body undergoes a circular S-curve wipe — a clip-path circle expands from the tail, slides along the body's S-curve spine, and floods the fish with its opposite color. Eyes flip at the geometrically precise moment the wipe circle covers them (t≈10.8%). A single shared drift-cycle keeps both halves perfectly synchronized. The border ring stays static throughout.

palette_groups.note: The two opposing fish colors. Curated as paired Options rather than RgbStyled to guarantee sufficient contrast between yin (darker principle) and yang (lighter principle). Each index in color-yin pairs with the same index in color-yang.

motion_groups.note: Single shared cycle duration. Controls the speed of the circular wipe across both fish bodies, both eye flips, and both clip-path animations. All 9 occurrences of drift-cycle in the template receive the same value. Slower = meditative, faster = energetic.
